TIME BUDGETS - Fig 3
```{r}
#Time budget plot
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#TRIMMED DATASET
#Count up total hours of footage
#LOGGIES
timebudget.cc <- data.ids.meanDBA %>%
  filter(!DeployID %in% c("CC-11-12_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR13", "CC-11-12_CR14", "CC-11-12_CR15", "CC-11-12_CR16", "CC-11-12_CR17",
                          "CC-11-12_CR18", "CC-11-12_CR19", "CC-11-145_CR2", "CC-11-145_CR3", "CC-11-145_CR4", "CC-11-145_CR5",
                          "CC-11-145_CR6")) %>%
  distinct(DeployID, Behavior, Segment, BehDuration) %>%
  group_by(DeployID, Behavior) %>%
  summarise(total_sec = sum(BehDuration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(DeployID) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * total_sec / sum(total_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
timebudget.cc

cc.timestats <- timebudget.cc %>%
  group_by(Behavior) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_percent = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop")
cc.timestats

#GREENS
timebudget.cm <- data.ids.meanDBA %>%
  filter(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-12_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR15", "CC-11-12_CR16", "CC-11-12_CR17", "CC-11-12_CR18", "CC-11-145_CR2",
                         "CC-11-145_CR3", "CC-11-145_CR4", "CC-11-145_CR5", "CC-11-145_CR6")) %>%
  distinct(DeployID, Behavior, Segment, BehDuration) %>%
  group_by(DeployID, Behavior) %>%
  summarise(total_sec = sum(BehDuration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(DeployID) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * total_sec / sum(total_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
timebudget.cm

cm.timestats <- timebudget.cm %>%
  group_by(Behavior) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_percent   = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop")
cm.timestats

#KEMPS
timebudget.lk <- data.ids.meanDBA %>%
  filter(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-12_CR13", "CC-11-12_CR14", "CC-11-12_CR19")) %>%
  distinct(DeployID, Behavior, Segment, BehDuration) %>%
```

```{r}
#STATS:  differences in % time spent on each behavior
#Histogram to glance at data distribution
timebudget.all %>%
  mutate(Behavior = as.factor(Behavior)) %>%
  group_by(Behavior, Species) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=percent))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(Behavior~Species)

cc_ids <- c("CC-11-11_CR10", "CC-11-11_CR12", "CC-11-11_CR13", "CC-11-11_CR14", "CC-11-11_CR15", "CC-11-11_CR16", "CC-11-11_CR17",
            "CC-11-11_CR18", "CC-11-11_CR19", "CC-11-11_CR21", "CC-11-11_CR22", "CC-11-11_CR4", "CC-11-11_CR5", "CC-11-11_CR6",
            "CC-11-11_CR7", "CC-11-11_CR8", "CC-11-11_CR9", "CC-11-12_CR10", "CC-11-12_CR11", "CC-11-12_CR3", "CC-11-12_CR4", 
            "CC-11-12_CR6", "CC-11-12_CR7", "CC-11-12_CR8", "CC-11-12_CR9", "CC-11-12_CR20")
cm_ids <- c("CC-11-12_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR15", "CC-11-12_CR16", "CC-11-12_CR17", "CC-11-12_CR18", "CC-11-145_CR2", "CC-11-145_CR3",
            "CC-11-145_CR4", "CC-11-145_CR5", "CC-11-145_CR6")
lk_ids <- c("CC-11-12_CR13", "CC-11-12_CR14", "CC-11-12_CR19") #connecting species to deployids to fill blanks below once i add in the zeros for behaviors turtles didnt exhibit

timebudget.all <- timebudget.all %>%
  mutate(prop = percent / 100) %>%
  complete(DeployID, Behavior, fill = list(prop = 0)) %>% #change percent column to a proportion between 0 - 1 to make beta regression run properly, add rows for 0s (e.g., if a turtle didn't forage gets a 0 for prop)
  mutate(total_sec = if_else(is.na(total_sec), 0, total_sec)) %>%
  mutate(percent = if_else(is.na(percent), 0, percent)) %>% #filling NAs with 0s
  mutate(
    Species = case_when(
      is.na(Species) & DeployID %in% cc_ids ~ "Loggerhead",
      is.na(Species) & DeployID %in% cm_ids ~ "Green",
      is.na(Species) & DeployID %in% lk_ids ~ "Kemp's ridley",  TRUE ~ Species)) #filling missing species

timebudget.all1 <- timebudget.all %>%
  filter(!DeployID %in% c("CC-11-12_CR13", "CC-11-12_CR14", "CC-11-12_CR19")) %>%
  group_by(DeployID) %>%
  mutate(total_obs_sec = sum(total_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(occur = as.integer(total_sec > 0))
timebudget.all1

# model for behavior occurrence
m_occ_species <- glm(occur ~ Species * Behavior, family = binomial, data = timebudget.all1) #binomial model for whether or not a behavior occurred
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
Anova(m_occ_species, type = 3)
emmeans(m_occ_species, pairwise ~ Species | Behavior, type = "response") #post-hoc for which behaviors were  different in occurrence between species (spoiler: none)
summary(m_occ_species)

#eliminate zeros as the next model is looking at how time spent varies if a behavior DID occur:
dat_pos <- timebudget.all1 %>% 
  filter(total_sec > 0)
dat_pos$Species <- factor(dat_pos$Species) #convert species to a factor

#model for if a behavior occurred, how do species and behavior affect amt time spent; accounts for observation time to normalize
m_amt_species <- glmmTMB(log(total_sec) ~ Species * Behavior + offset(log(total_obs_sec)) + (1 | DeployID), dispformula = ~ Behavior, family = gaussian, data = dat_pos) 
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
Anova(m_amt_species, type = 3)
emmeans(m_amt_species, pairwise ~ Species | Behavior, type = "response") #post-hoc for which behaviors were  different in time spent between species (cc spent more time swimming and breathing than cm)

#checking model assumptions
res_occ_species <- simulateResiduals(m_occ_species) 
plot(res_occ_species) #good; looks uniform and dispersion test not significant 
res_amt_species <- simulateResiduals(m_amt_species)
plot(res_amt_species) #good; looks uniform and dispersion test not significant 
#duration model assumes positive (yes, good), right-skewed (but then more even using the log; yes, good) data
hist(dat_pos$total_sec) #good, right skewed
hist(log(dat_pos$total_sec)) #good, more even
#normality of random intercepts
ran <- ranef(m_amt_species)$cond$DeployID[,1]
qqnorm(ran)
qqline(ran) #good

```

```{r}
#CREATE predicted time budg model and plot predicted means 
new.length <- dat_pos %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pred = predict(m_amt_species, newdata = ., re.form = NULL, type = "response"))
library(emmeans)
timebudg.ci <- emmeans(m_amt_species, ~ Behavior * Species, type = "response", offset = 0)

#plot predicted means
#arranging things with enough space to include Lk (otherwise there's overlap since Lk only has data for 1/3 layers)
sp_levels   <- c("Loggerhead", "Green", "Kemp's ridley")
beh_levels <- c("Swimming", "Resting", "Foraging", "Breathing", "Species Interaction", "Other")

timebudget.all <- timebudget.all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Species  = factor(Species, levels = sp_levels),
         Behavior = factor(Behavior, levels = beh_levels))

timebudg.df <- as.data.frame(timebudg.ci) %>%
  mutate(across(c(response, lower.CL, upper.CL), ~ .x * 100),
         Species  = factor(Species, levels = sp_levels),
         Behavior = factor(Behavior, levels = beh_levels),
         xpos = as.numeric(Behavior) + (as.numeric(Species) - 2) * dodge / 3)

sp_colors <- c("Loggerhead" = "#FF7575", "Green" = "#5CDEAB", "Kemp's ridley" = "#C08DFF")

timebudg.predplot <- ggplot(timebudget.all, aes(Behavior, fill = Species)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(y = percent, color = Species), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = dodge),
              alpha = 0.4, size = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = timebudg.df, aes(x = xpos, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.08, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = timebudg.df, aes(x = xpos, y = response, fill = Species), shape = 21, size = 2, color = "black", show.legend = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent of time spent (%)", color = "Sea Turtle Species") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2)), color = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = sp_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sp_colors, limits = sp_levels, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme( #making background transparent
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), legend.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Species Interaction" = "Species\ninteraction")) +  
  theme(  
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), #angle = 45, hjust = 1, 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    text = element_text(family = "Segoe UI"),
    legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/Analysis/Figures/timebudg.predplot.png", timebudg.predplot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

INTERACTION COUNTS - Fig 4
```{r}
#Plot # of occurrences of each interaction type for each turtle
type_counts <- data.ids.meanDBA %>%
  filter(Subject == "CATS Turtle", Behavior == "Species Interaction") %>% 
  distinct(DeployNum, InteractionType, Segment) %>%  
  count(DeployNum, InteractionType, name = "NumSegments")
type_counts

characteristics <- data.ids.meanDBA %>%
  filter(Subject == "CATS Turtle", Behavior == "Species Interaction") %>% 
  distinct(DeployNum, InteractionType, SpeciesSubject, SpeciesInteractingWith, Segment) %>%  
  count(InteractionType, SpeciesSubject, SpeciesInteractingWith, name = "NumSegments") %>%
  group_by(SpeciesSubject) %>%
  mutate(SpeciesCombo = paste(SpeciesSubject, SpeciesInteractingWith, sep = "-")) %>%
  mutate(InteractionType = factor(InteractionType, levels = c("Aggressive", "Active", "Passive"))) %>%
  mutate(SpeciesCombo = factor(SpeciesCombo, levels = c("Cc-Cc", "Cm-Cm", "Cc-Cm", "Cm-Cc", "Cc-Lk", "Lk-Cm"))) 

#change species names to reflect common name instead of latin abbreviations
characteristics1 <- characteristics %>%
  mutate(SpeciesCombo = gsub("Cc", "Loggerhead", SpeciesCombo),
       SpeciesCombo = gsub("Cm", "Green", SpeciesCombo),
       SpeciesCombo = gsub("Lk", "Kemp's ridley", SpeciesCombo),
       SpeciesCombo = factor(SpeciesCombo, 
                              levels = c("Loggerhead-Loggerhead", "Green-Green", 
                                         "Loggerhead-Green", "Green-Loggerhead", "Loggerhead-Kemp's ridley", "Kemp's ridley-Green")))

#PLOT - COUNTS OF INTERACTIONS BY TYPE AND SP
characteristics.plot <- ggplot(characteristics1, aes(x = SpeciesCombo, y = NumSegments, fill = InteractionType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 27), breaks = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Passive" = "#75BDFF", "Active" = "#FFD875", "Aggressive" = "#FF75AE"),
                    breaks = c("Passive", "Active", "Aggressive")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = NumSegments), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "black", size = 6, family = "Segoe UI") +
  labs(x = "Turtle Species", y = "Number of Interactions",
    fill = "Interaction Type") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme( #making background transparent
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), legend.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt")), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt"))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), legend.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        text = element_text(family = "Segoe UI"),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Cc" = "Loggerhead", "Cm" = "Green")) +
  geom_bracket(data = NULL, inherit.aes = FALSE, xmin = 0.6, xmax = 2.4, y.position = 27, label = "Intraspecific", label.size = 6) +
  geom_bracket(data = NULL, inherit.aes = FALSE, xmin = 2.6, xmax = 6.4, y.position = 27, label = "Interspecific", label.size = 6)
```

```{r}
  filter(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-11_CR10", "CC-11-11_CR12", "CC-11-11_CR13", "CC-11-11_CR14", "CC-11-11_CR15", "CC-11-11_CR17",
                        "CC-11-11_CR19", "CC-11-11_CR21", "CC-11-11_CR5", "CC-11-11_CR6", "CC-11-11_CR7", "CC-11-11_CR8", "CC-11-11_CR9", 
                        "CC-11-12_CR11", "CC-11-12_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR13", "CC-11-12_CR15", "CC-11-12_CR16", "CC-11-12_CR17", "CC-11-12_CR3",
                        "CC-11-12_CR7", "CC-11-12_CR9", "CC-11-145_CR2", "CC-11-145_CR4", "CC-11-145_CR5")) %>%
  group_by(DeployID, ObservID) %>%
  summarise(
    VideoLength = as.numeric(difftime(dplyr::first(ObsEndTime), dplyr::first(ObsStartTime), units = "secs")),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(DeployID) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalFootageSecs = sum(VideoLength, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r}
#comparing between species

#model
time.m <- glmmTMB(BehDuration ~ InteractionType * Species + (1|DeployID), family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = interaction_length.no.lk) 
summary(time.m)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
Anova(time.m, type = 3) # stats for interaction duration across types; there was a significant difference in mean interaction duration across interaction types (Cc)
emmeans(time.m, pairwise ~ InteractionType * Species, type = "response") 
#checking model assumptions
#data is all positive and right-skewed; model assumes this so fits well (gamma):
hist(interaction_length.no.lk$BehDuration) #good
#model also assumes that variance increases w mean (longer behaviors are more variable) (gamma)
#assumes multiplicative effects of interaction type:
ggplot(interaction_length.no.lk, aes(x = InteractionType, y = BehDuration)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() #good
time.m.test <- simulateResiduals(time.m)
plot(time.m.test)
table(interaction_length.no.lk$InteractionType) # passive has a much higher sample size (23 vs 8 or 11)- should be noted, but otherwise good
#assumes normally distributed deployment-level random intercepts:
ranef_vals <- ranef(time.m)$cond$DeployID[,1]
qqnorm(ranef_vals)
qqline(ranef_vals) #good; points follow line well
testDispersion(res) #good; not significant


#CREATE predicted beh duration model and plot predicted means 
new.length <- interaction_length.no.lk %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pred = predict(time.m, newdata = ., re.form = NULL, type = "response"))
library(emmeans)

length.df <- as.data.frame(length.ci)

#plot predicted means over raw/actual data
#arranging things with enough space to include Lk (otherwise there's overlap since Lk only has data for 1/3 layers)
sp_levels   <- c("Loggerhead", "Green", "Kemp's ridley")

length.df <- as.data.frame(length.ci) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = sp_levels),
         InteractionType = factor(InteractionType, levels = type_levels),

sp_colors <- c("Loggerhead" = "#FF7575", "Green" = "#5CDEAB", "Kemp's ridley" = "#C08DFF")

intdur.predplot <- ggplot(time.all, aes(InteractionType, fill = Species)) +

              alpha = 0.4, size = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
```

```{r}
#FIG 6 PUB PLOT CODE HERE!
#MODELING DBA
#predicting mean DBA and then plotting predicted values
#unforch cant compare sp bc of biological differences due to major size class differences

#CC df
dba.allcc <- dba.all %>%
  filter(Species == "Loggerhead") 
dba.allcc2 <- dba.allcc %>%
  mutate(BehDuration = median(dba.allcc$BehDuration))
#cm DF
dba.allcm <- dba.all %>%
  filter(Species == "Green") 
dba.allcm2 <- dba.allcm %>%
  mutate(BehDuration = median(dba.allcm$BehDuration))

#CC model
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
dba.m.cc <- glmmTMB(MeanDBA ~ Behavior + offset(log(BehDuration)) + (1|DeployID), family = t_family(link = 'log'), data = dba.allcc2)
Anova(dba.m.cc, type = 3)
#Post hoc to see which behaviors were statistically different from each other
#Behavior differences within each species
emm_behav.cc <- emmeans(dba.m.cc, ~ Behavior) #can no longer use emmeans(dba.m.cc, ~ Behavior | Species)
pairs(emm_behav.cc)
#Checking model assumptions
#model assumes that MeanDBA is positive and continuous
summary(dba.allcc2$MeanDBA)
any(dba.allcc2$MeanDBA <= 0) #good
#model assumes normality on log scale
test.dba.m.cc <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = dba.m.cc, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(dba.m.cc) #looks good
plot(test.dba.m.cc)
#normal distribution of random effects
ranef(dba.m.cc)$cond$DeployID
qqnorm(ranef(dba.m.cc)$cond$DeployID[[1]])
qqline(ranef(dba.m.cc)$cond$DeployID[[1]]) #good, mostly linear
#no overdispersion:
library(DHARMa)
res <- simulateResiduals(dba.m.cc)
testDispersion(res) #good; not significant

#CM Model
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
dba.m.cm <- glmmTMB(MeanDBA ~ Behavior + offset(log(BehDuration)) + (1|DeployID), family = t_family(link = 'log'), data = dba.allcm2)
Anova(dba.m.cm, type = 3)
#Post hoc to see which behaviors were statistically different from each other
#Behavior differences within each species
emm_behav.cm <- emmeans(dba.m.cm, ~ Behavior)
pairs(emm_behav.cm)
#Checking model assumptions
#model assumes that MeanDBA is positive and continuous
summary(dba.allcm2$MeanDBA)
any(dba.allcm2$MeanDBA <= 0) #good
#model assumes normality on log scale
test.dba.m.cm <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = dba.m.cm, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(dba.m.cm) #looks good
plot(test.dba.m.cm)
#normal distribution of random effects
ranef(dba.m.cm)$cond$DeployID
qqnorm(ranef(dba.m.cm)$cond$DeployID[[1]])
qqline(ranef(dba.m.cm)$cond$DeployID[[1]]) #good, mostly linear
#no overdispersion:
library(DHARMa)
res <- simulateResiduals(dba.m.cm)
testDispersion(res) #good; not significant
```

```{r}
    mutate(Species  = factor(sp, levels = sp_levels),
```
